description: Original modular algorithm and independent finite oracle
state: Deterministic residues, explicit length and allocation errors
cost: For n<=4096, O(n²+n log p) modular operations and three O(n) vectors. Fixed prime inversion is bounded; copying full vectors keeps worst-case quadratic work even for smaller order. Cap is a resource policy.
forward: For normalized finite s, find minimum L such that s[t]=sum(c[j]*s[t-1-j]) for L<=t<n. The connection polynomial starts with1. A nonzero discrepancy is canceled using a shifted prior polynomial and its nonzero discrepancy inverse; when 2L<=t update L=t+1-L. Return negated nonconstant coefficients in lag order. The concrete update schedule chooses one compatible solution, not all solutions.
